desc.health:
Health determines the resilience to death.
Each point of health can take 3 points of damage.
desc.might:
Might increases the maximum damage of abilities.
Each point of might increases maximum damage by 34%.
desc.wits:
Wits determine the cooldown duration of abilities.
Each point of wits decrease cooldowns by approximately 10%, with diminishing returns.

tips.start:
This is your character selection screen.
Click <REROLL> to choose another unit to play as or click <START> to begin.
tips.prepare:
This is your preparation menu.
You can buy items, evolve with runes, and depart to various levels.
tips.level:
You can move around by dragging your cursor anywhere on the screen.
You will automatically attack enemies within attack range.
tips.death: When you die, you lose all progress on your unit including stats and items.
